identity_and_branding.logo_concept: Custom RP monogram in glowing SVG geometric line art

effects: 1px subtle borders with hover glow effect
Grain overlay texture at 3% opacity to remove digital flatness
Interactive dot-matrix/grid background in hero section

sections.name: Navigation Header
sections.description: Sticky top bar with RP Monogram logo, smooth anchor links (Projects, Stack, AI Workflows, Services, Contact), status pulse badge, and Contact CTA button.

sections.name: Kinetic Hero
sections.description: Line-by-line staggered text reveal, large Ram Pravesh Sahni headline, dynamic auto-rotating role typewriter, live 'Available for Hire' badge with pulsing green light, quick metric pills (3+ Yrs Exp, 15+ Delivered Projects, 99.9% API Uptime), direct CTAs to 'Explore Projects' and 'Hire Me'.

sections.name: Projects Showcase (Core Ask)
sections.description: Interactive project gallery with category filters (All, Backend, Web, Mobile, AI & Automation). 6 featured project cards with numbered index (01 - 06), tech stack pills, architecture highlights, live preview modal / code breakdown trigger.

projects_list.title: Billing & Invoice API
projects_list.desc: High-concurrency microservice handling secure invoice generation, PDF exports, and payment gateway webhooks.

projects_list.title: Realtime Chat Service
projects_list.desc: Ultra-low latency WebSocket chat server supporting 10k+ concurrent connections with pub/sub architecture.

projects_list.title: Business Dashboard
projects_list.desc: Analytics & financial management portal featuring real-time telemetry, dark theme visuals, and exportable reports.

projects_list.title: Delivery Tracking App
projects_list.desc: Cross-platform mobile application with live GPS driver movement, push alerts, and order lifecycle management.

projects_list.title: Lead-to-WhatsApp Automation
projects_list.desc: Zero-human workflow routing incoming lead forms through AI qualification directly into WhatsApp conversations.

projects_list.title: Support Chatbot with RAG
projects_list.desc: Context-aware AI knowledge assistant fetching dynamic company docs via retrieval-augmented generation.

sections.name: Tech Stack Section
sections.description: Grouped grid of technologies organized into 6 clear tabs/cards: Backend, Databases, Frontend, Mobile, Cloud & DevOps, AI & Automation. Includes skill depth indicator and interactive tech pill hover states.

sections.name: AI Automation Workflows
sections.description: Interactive n8n flow visualizer showing step-by-step data movement (Trigger → n8n workflow → AI Model → Your Data → Action) with 4 clickable use cases and live step preview.

sections.name: Services Offered
sections.description: 4 strategic service cards: 1) Backend & APIs, 2) Websites & Web Apps, 3) Mobile Apps, 4) Cloud & DevOps. Details deliverable timeline, stack used, and direct enquiry trigger.

sections.name: Editorial Marquee Banner
sections.description: Continuous slow-moving ticker displaying key values: FULL-STACK DEVELOPMENT • HIGH PERFORMANCE APIS • AI WORKFLOW AUTOMATION • FLUTTER MOBILE APPS • DEOGHAR TO GLOBAL

sections.name: Contact & Enquiry Section
sections.description: Working contact form submitting to FastAPI backend (/api/contact) with toast notifications, paired with quick contact cards (Email, Phone, WhatsApp, Deoghar Location).

sections.name: Footer
sections.description: Minimalist technical footer with RP monogram, social icons, copyright notice, and scroll-to-top button.

animations.fade_in_up: Initial y: 20, opacity: 0; animate to y: 0, opacity: 1 over 0.5s easeOut
animations.stagger_children: staggerChildren: 0.1s for cards and list items

accessibility.contrast_ratio: APCA AA compliant, min 4.5:1 text contrast against dark backgrounds

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive elements carry clear kebab-case data-testid attributes.
Do NOT use generic Inter font for main headings; stick to Syne / Plus Jakarta Sans.
Maintain high dark mode contrast; text must remain crisp and readable against deep charcoal and black backgrounds.
Wire up the contact form to the FastAPI backend at /api/contact and show a Sonner toast notification on success.
Keep smooth motion natural with Lenis and Framer Motion stagger animations.
